title: Nicki Minaj 03
name: nicki-minaj-03
arc:
A Nicki hip pop. Weight is over the character-left foot with the arms up at shoulder height; the character-right foot lifts and taps at frames 3 and 11, and again through 14-16, before the figure centres at frame 17.

Pop the hip on each lift. Pingpong: frames 0 and 22 are grounded turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight over the character-left foot, both feet down. character-left knee slightly bent, character-right knee slightly bent. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm at shoulder height, elbow bent ~90°, out to the side. character-right arm low by the hip, elbow straight, out to the side. torso upright. character-right hip raised. head forward.
